text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Mmh~~! I'm itching to go! I wanna run 
already!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Because I feel like I can get an amazing 
result today!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
We had carrot rice for breakfast! And the 
Carrot Princess told me in my dream that 
I'd "win"! Plus—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Trainer and I worked so hard that we won't 
lose to anyone!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Leave it to me! Alright, let's do this, 
let's do thiiis!"
